name: 4a-mods
description: 4A-Mods: Claude Code mods by 4AM. Cache Keeper shows costs as plan-limit percent instead of dollars; Model Router gives Claude one agent type per model and effort tier.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: One agent type per model and effort tier (Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for standard coding, Opus for hard engineering), from one tier table kept current through pull requests; /route routes Haiku up to Opus, /route fable up to Fable
